chat: Doctor: Could you tell me more about how the gait and limb ataxia developed—was it sudden or gradual, and has it been worsening over time? Have you experienced any recent falls or balance issues?

It started gradually over the past few months, and yes, I’ve had a couple of falls recently when trying to navigate uneven surfaces. The weakness in my right arm has also gotten a bit worse, especially when I try to lift something.

Doctor: Has the patient had any recent infections or illnesses before the onset of ataxia? Any history of neurological conditions, autoimmune diseases, or family history of movement disorders? Also, have there been any recent changes in vision, speech, or swallowing?

I haven’t had any recent infections, but I do have Crohn disease, which has been hard to control. No history of neurological conditions, and I don’t think it runs in my family. I haven’t noticed changes in vision, speech, or swallowing, though.
